_comment: The midwimble testnet's parameters. scripts/join_testnet.py builds from
exactly these values and refuses to run unless the binary it produces
prints genesis_block below, so every joiner is provably on one chain.
Filled in on testnet launch day by whoever launches it: run
set_launch_params.py --testnet with the day's anchors, then copy the
values it wrote (and the genesis block id `midwimble params` prints)
